kebab_example: aliyun apig create-migration-task --cluster-id c-xxxxxx --description migration_from_Nginx --environment-id env-xxxx --gateway-id gw-xxxx --http-api-id api-xxxx --ingress-class nginx --migration-type Nginx_Ingress --watch-namespace default --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateMigrationTask

parameters.help_en: The ID of the source ACK cluster. The value must be the same as the cluster specified in the IngressInfo of the API. Note: This parameter is actually required. If this parameter is not specified, the API returns 400 InvalidParameter.IsEmpty
parameters.help_zh:
源 ACK 集群 ID，须与 API 的 IngressInfo 中集群一致
注意：本参数实际为必填项；未提供时，API 返回 400 InvalidParameter.IsEmpty
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en: The description of the task. The description is stored only when the task is created
parameters.help_zh: 任务描述，仅在创建时落库
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: The ID of the destination environment. The value must be the same as the Ingress import environment of the API. Note: This parameter is actually required. If this parameter is not specified, the API returns 400 InvalidParameter.IsEmpty. You can call ListEnvironments to query existing environment IDs. CreateEnvironment has been deprecated
parameters.help_zh: 目标环境 ID，必须与 API 的 Ingress 导入环境一致。注意：本参数实际为必填项；未提供时，API 返回 400 InvalidParameter.IsEmpty。可调用 ListEnvironments 查询已有环境 ID；CreateEnvironment 已标记为废弃
parameters.name: environment_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the destination gateway to which traffic is migrated
parameters.help_zh: 目标网关 ID（迁移流量切到该网关）
parameters.name: gateway_id

parameters.help_en: The HTTP API ID. The API must have been imported as an Ingress type (HttpIngress) API. Note: This parameter is actually required. If this parameter is not specified, the API returns 400 InvalidParameter.IsEmpty
parameters.help_zh: HTTP API ID，必须已导入为 Ingress 类型（HttpIngress）的 API。注意：本参数实际为必填项；未提供时，API 返回 400 InvalidParameter.IsEmpty
parameters.name: http_api_id

parameters.help_en: The Ingress class. If specified, the value must be the same as the API import configuration. Otherwise, an ingress class conflict error is returned
parameters.help_zh: Ingress Class，传入时须与 API 导入配置一致，否则报 ingress class conflict
parameters.name: ingress_class

parameters.help_en:
The migration type.
[_single.params.body.props.migrationType.enum.Nginx Ingress]Nginx Ingress migration
parameters.name: migration_type

parameters.help_en: The watched namespace. If specified, the value must be the same as the API import configuration. Otherwise, a watchNamespace conflict error is returned
parameters.help_zh: 监听的命名空间，传入时须与 API 导入配置一致，否则报 watchNamespace conflict
parameters.name: watch_namespace
